name: Balatongyörök (Hungary)
description: White field with a blue vertical stripe at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Balatongyörök (a yellow and green shield with a bunch of grapes, a sun, an anchor and a fish) above a yellow scroll inscribed BALATONGYÖRÖK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
